subject: ANGL
title: Anglais A4 (4e année)
source: Fiche de progression harmonisée nationale A4, 2026/2027

chapters.title: Module 1 – Using language to talk about national integration and diversity acceptance

lessons.title: Situation 1: Interacting with peers from other tribes and cultures in Cameroon (present tenses)
Situation 2: Socialising with friends and neighbours of other religions (adjuncts)
Situation 3: Tolerating and accepting others (ellipsis)
Situation 4: Taking part in cross-national celebrations (definite and indefinite articles)

chapters.title: Module 2 – Using language to talk about consumption habits and how they impact economic and social life

lessons.title: Situation 1: Going to a restaurant (comparatives)
Situation 2: Inquiring about accommodation (expressions of purpose)
Situation 3: Finding best buys (complex sentences)
Situation 4: Participating in leisure activities

chapters.title: Module 3 – Using language to talk about climate change and maintaining hygiene and sanitation

lessons.title: Situation 1: Being concerned about environmental issues (relative clauses)
Situation 2: Keeping informed about weather conditions (direct and indirect speech)
Situation 3: Finding out about climate change and global warming (first and second conditionals)
Situation 4: Finding out about garbage collection and recycling services (structures with adjectives)

chapters.title: Module 4 – Using language to talk about the quest for excellence, gender issues and democracy

lessons.title: Situation 1: Volunteering in gender equality promotion activities (active and passive voices)
Situation 2: Participating in training activities and courses on democracy (question tags)
Situation 3: Taking part in polls and surveys (word order in questions)
Situation 4: Campaigning and voting for school prefects (phrasal verbs)

chapters.title: Module 5 – Using language to explore utilities of modern technology

lessons.title: Situation 1: Subscribing to service packages (telephone and internet services)
Situation 2: Complaining about service quality (comparatives of adjectives)
Situation 3: Facing difficulties with Android phones, iPads and latest gadgets (conditionals)
Situation 4: Relaxing with video games, computers and phones (sequence markers)
